selector.scenario_definition: one fixed permutation/input/guard variant or one twelve-step seeded trace; peeks are not trades

budget.actual_cpu_id: record observed one allowed CPU; do not infer CPU ID1

execution_scope: Compile/execute only selected actual AST definitions using memory rows, inert native component stand-ins and original constructor declarations for clock-code metadata. Independent expected priority re-sorts current rows on every peek.
forbidden: original matching suite or other old target rerun
first_raw_required: complete stdout/stderr with any first failure
operation_count_scope: One128-row memory adapter and20iterations: only full-read/point-read request counts; not SQL query-plan, walltime, TPS or settlement evidence.
acceptance_limit: Any pure PASS is selector/guard component evidence only. Real SQLite matching, risk, fees, two-leg settlement, concurrent writer exclusion, restart reconciliation, performance and production activation remain NOT_RUN/NO_GO.

raw_capture_contract.partial_or_failed_write: reservation remains consumed; sticky failure; one bounded trailer attempt then own os._exit125
raw_capture_contract.streams: sys.stdout,sys.stderr and both Python fallback streams replaced before fixture/import/main execution
raw_capture_contract.domain: frozen memory-only fixture uses Python streams; no native FD emitter or child
raw_capture_contract.pre_execution_scope: interpreter startup/missing-source failures separate; no fixture invocation when source preparation fails
